title: Bass Player Wanted
cn: 第 13 集 · 招聘贝斯手
novel:
The gang [[encountered|encounter]] a [[troublemaker|troublemaker]] at the Farhampton Inn. The man was a bass player who had been hired for the wedding band. However, he turned out to be incredibly [[rude|rude]] and [[annoying|annoying]] to everyone he met.

The bass player [[insulted|insult]] Ted's clothes, made fun of Marshall's job, and [[criticized|criticize]] Robin's choice of wedding decorations. Nobody could figure out why he was being so [[hostile|hostile]]. Lily tried to be nice to him, but he rejected her kindness.

Meanwhile, Marshall finally [[arrived|arrive]] at the Farhampton Inn after his long cross-country journey with Daphne. He was [[exhausted|exhausted]] from the drive but [[relieved|relieve]] to be at the wedding. Marvin was sleeping peacefully in his arms.

The gang [[greeted|greet]] Marshall with cheers and hugs. They had been worried about him making it in time for the wedding. Marshall was [[grateful|grateful]] for their warm welcome.

The bass player continued to cause problems throughout the day. He [[argued|argue]] with the other band members and [[refused|refuse]] to play the songs on the playlist. The gang [[warned|warn]] the wedding planner about his behavior.

Ted eventually [[discovered|discover]] that the bass player was someone he had wronged years ago. The man held a grudge against Ted and was using this opportunity to get [[revenge|revenge]]. Ted [[apologized|apologize]] for his past mistake, and the bass player finally calmed down.

By the end of the day, the bass player agreed to behave professionally at the wedding. The gang was glad that the conflict was [[resolved|resolve]]. They enjoyed the rest of the evening together, happy that the whole group was finally [[reunited|reunite]] under one roof.

troublemaker.en: The troublemaker was sent to the office.

rude.en: He was rude to the waiter.

insult.en: He insulted her in front of everyone.

hostile.en: He was hostile to the new employee.

exhausted.en: He was exhausted after the race.

relieve.en: She was relieved to see him.

greet.en: They greeted the guests at the door.

grateful.en: He was grateful for the gift.

warn.en: He warned her about the danger.

revenge.en: He wanted revenge for the insult.
